text:
{"content":"Save remains enabled and starts a transaction when an active field has valid:false. The dialog calculates canSave=false, but neither button state nor save() uses that result. saveCalendarEventEdit also ignores draft validation.","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"P2. Save bypasses the existing invalid-field contract. CodeRabbit reported this concern; independent checks confirmed it.","rationale":"test_calendarEventCreateEditState explicitly requires that an invalid section blocks Save. The new button checks only readiness and operation status. The helper checks only source, mode, operation status, and draft presence. Reading the field-owned validity result does not require Save to implement field validation.","recommendation":"change","validation":"The exact dialog class, with controlled DOM and Save helper, reported canSave=false while leaving Save enabled and invoking the helper. A separate execution of the actual Save helper and reducers returned success and made one transaction call with title validity set to false. No Thunderbird runtime test ran.","appliedSummary":"Updated the dialog, Save helper, and shared selector. Invalid active fields now block Save. Disabled rows retain their draft values and permit Save.

Added coverage in three test files for rejection, retry, disabled rows, and Undo.

Lint, syntax checks, seven state tasks in Node, controlled checks, and `git diff --check` passed. Thunderbird runtime tests remain unrun because available builds report `SourceStamp=unknown`.

All six file edits remain unstaged and uncommitted.","changeSummary":"Honor known invalid active fields in the Save button and Save entry paths. Add rejection coverage. Preserve disabled-row behavior.","state":"ready","changeAccepted":true,"changeReverted":false,"changesAmended":false}
